notes: 0.18.10 - PR #26 test build (stacked on PRs #17-#25, none merged). Settings is reorganized: a search box at the top, and the index grouped into Personalization (Horizon, Layout Studio, Appearance), Navigation (Edge controls, Workspace, Apps & navigation) and System (Device & setup, Updates). Controls anywhere moves to its own Edge controls screen. Scenes are retired: the Scene Architect, its Home and Reach entry points, and scene restoration are removed; a previously saved scene is simply ignored. The pie, rings and slice editors are unchanged - the picker's app list now comes from a Scenes-free helper.
